name: Render
description: Render's official MCP server lets AI apps and agents manage your Render infrastructure through natural language. Create and deploy web services, static sites, and cron jobs; provision Render Postgres and Key Value instances; trigger and inspect deploys; update environment variables and compute plans; stream logs; analyze performance metrics; and run read-only SQL against your Postgres — all scoped to a workspace you choose. Hosted by Render at https://mcp.render.com/mcp, it connects over OAuth (or a Render API key) and is designed to keep secrets like connection strings out of your AI app's context.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Render to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Render to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.render.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Is Render MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 14, 2026, Render scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Render MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Render lists 25 MCP tools, including create_cron_job, create_key_value, create_postgres, create_static_site, create_web_service, get_deploy, get_key_value, get_metrics, get_postgres, get_selected_workspace, get_service, and list_deploys.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Render?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Render in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Render requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Why is Render failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Render scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is Authenticated MCP access is available. Reconnect the server account or provide a valid refreshable OAuth session, then rerun the audit. Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
Render is developed by Render. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
